contracts.description: (2020) Valentine's Day is (was) right around the corner and chocolate makers are working overtime to meet orders!

contracts.name: The Classic
contracts.description: (2023) After a few years out of fashion, Chocolate has returned as this years desired Valentines gift - Chocolate eggs are a top choice.

contracts.name: Valentine Invitation
contracts.description: You have been invited to produce chocolate for Valentines inside a compound of a mysterious candy mogul!

contracts.name: A Trip Back
contracts.description: (2019) People are honoring the sacrifices of those who serve by taking a trip back in time. Help them on their journey.

contracts.name: Video Games
contracts.description: (2020) With folks playing more PC and Console games than ever before, home energy needs are up!

contracts.name: Diapers Everywhere!
contracts.description: (2019) The creator of Egg, Inc. (me) just had a baby!  I need y'all to work together to make me some quantum waste pails to help with all the diapers!

contracts.name: Waffles
contracts.description: Waffles with real eggs are exploding in popularity driving demand for Edible Eggs - however new regulations are driving up Research Costs!

contracts.name: Water Main Break
contracts.description: (2021) A water main break has left millions without water until repairs can be completed. Help is needed.

contracts.name: Heating Up
contracts.description: (2020) Summer is heating up and you know what that means.... Waterballoon fight!

contracts.name: Summer Sunset
contracts.description: The local town has commissioned you to create the waterballoons for the end of summer waterballoon fight! (2018)

contracts.name: Winter Break
contracts.description: (2018) It's Winter Break! And since break homework was deemed cruel and unusual punishment, Prodigy Eggs are all the rage!

contracts.name: The Thaw
contracts.description: (2021) After a winter storm wreaked havoc on parts of the country, materials are needed to repair and rebuild.

contracts.name: Winter Heat
contracts.description: A record breaking heatwave sweeps the nation before winter is through, a niche egg type is finding new uses and suppliers are needed!

contracts.name: Water Cup
contracts.description: (2022) As the World Cup comes to a close, Quatar's desalination plants are tapped, they have ordered more water!

contracts.name: World Record Egg
contracts.description: (2019) With a simple picture of an Egg becoming the most liked social media post, demand for the classic is booming!

contracts.name: Holiday Lights
contracts.description: (2019) With homes and businesses firing up their Holiday lights and decorations, local power generation needs more juice!

contracts.name: Last Minute Shipping
contracts.description: (2019) Shipping companies are slammed! More Quantum storage is needed!

contracts.name: Quantum Trash Bags
contracts.description: (2018) With all the wrapping paper and boxes to throw out, Quantum Trash bags are flying off the shelves!

contracts.name: Yard Decorations
contracts.description: (2021) Holiday yard decorating contest season has started and the DIY crowd is out in FORCE! Supplies are needed!

contracts.name: Yolk Screen
contracts.description: (2022) A new type of sunscreen made from Medical Egg Yolk is rapidly gaining popularity. With summer starting, supplies are needed!
